data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Strengthen dd-5 bundle contract — bundle MUST include pass/fail status from each of dd-1 through dd-4 PLUS overall_result derived via AND-logic across all four. dd5.json schema additions: {phase, artifacts: [...], bundled_at, epic_id, dd1_pass: bool, dd2_pass: bool, dd3_pass: bool, dd4_pass: bool, overall_result: bool} where overall_result = dd1_pass AND dd2_pass AND dd3_pass AND dd4_pass. Closes the gap where a partial bundle could satisfy dd-5 while upstream dimensions failed.
